responses.analysis: My prompt didn't improve the result much compared to the original prompts. Like the third prompt, the robot reached (1,1) but couldn't get past that point. It made 20 blocked moves and stopped 16 times, compared to 22 blocked moves and 22 stops in the third run. This shows that giving more specific instructions doesn't always mean the robot will follow them correctly.
